title: DPD
summary: DPD is part of Geopost, one of the world leading parcel delivery networks operating in more than 50 countries. Their 57,000 delivery experts deliver more than 8 million parcels worldwide each day through the brands DPD, Chronopost, SEUR, BRT, Speedy and Jadlog.
